en.t: Elderly Byzantine Emperor Michael VI Bringas abdicates after just one year on the throne
en.s: Michael VI Bringas (Greek: Μιχαήλ Βρίγγας, romanized: Mikhaḗl Brîngas; died c. 1057), also called Stratiotikos (Greek: Στρατιωτικός, "the military one, the warlike") and the Old (Greek: Γέρων, Geron), reigned as Byzantine emperor from 1056 to 1057.

zh.t: 年迈的拜占庭皇帝米海尔六世·布林加斯在登基仅一年后退位
zh.s: 米海尔六世·布林加斯（希腊语：Μιχαήλ Βρίγγας，罗马化：Mikhaḗl Brîngas；约卒于1057年），又称“斯特拉蒂奥蒂科斯”（希腊语：Στρατιωτικός，意为“军人、好战者”）和“老人”（希腊语：Γέρων，Geron），于1056年至1057年担任拜占庭皇帝。

en.s: The Battle of al-Funaydiq took place on 30 August 1060, between the forces of the Fatimid Caliphate under Nasir al-Dawla Ibn Hamdan, and the forces of the renegade Mirdasid chieftain of the Banu Kilab, Mahmud ibn Nasr, who aimed to capture Aleppo. The battle was a comprehensive defeat for the Fatimids after their Bedouin allies switched sides, resulting in the capture of Ibn Hamdan and most of his commanders.

zh.s: 1060年8月30日，法蒂玛王朝军队在纳赛尔·道莱·伊本·哈姆丹率领下，与意图攻占阿勒颇的米尔达西叛将、巴努·基拉卜部族首领马哈茂德·伊本·纳斯尔的部队交战。法蒂玛王朝的贝都因盟军倒戈，导致其惨败；伊本·哈姆丹及其大部分将领被俘。

en.s: The siege of Jacob's Ford was a victory of the Muslim Sultan Saladin over an unnamed Templar Castellan of Jacob's Ford. It occurred in August 1179, when Saladin conquered and destroyed Chastelet, a new border castle built by the Knights Templar at Jacob's Ford on the upper Jordan River, a historic passage point between the Golan Heights and north Galilee.

zh.s: 雅各布渡口围城战以穆斯林苏丹萨拉丁击败一名未具名的圣殿骑士城堡总管告终。1179年8月，萨拉丁攻占并摧毁了雅各布渡口的圣殿骑士新建边境城堡“沙泰莱堡”。雅各布渡口位于约旦河上游，是戈兰高地与加利利北部之间一处历史渡口。

en.s: The Battle of Lake Poyang (Chinese: 鄱陽湖之戰; pinyin: Póyáng Hú Zhīzhàn) was a naval battle which took place (30 August – 4 October 1363) between the rebel forces of Zhu Yuanzhang and Chen Youliang during the Red Turban Rebellion which led to the fall of the Yuan dynasty. Chen Youliang besieged Nanchang with a large fleet on Lake Poyang, one of China's largest freshwater lakes, and Zhu Yuanzhang met his force with a smaller fleet.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鄱阳湖之战（中文：鄱陽湖之戰；拼音：Póyáng Hú Zhīzhàn）是红巾军起义期间的一场水战，于1363年8月30日至10月4日在朱元璋和陈友谅的叛军之间展开。这场战争最终导致元朝覆亡。陈友谅率大舰队围攻鄱阳湖畔的南昌，朱元璋则率较小舰队迎战。

en.s: The siege of Kőszeg (Hungarian: Kőszeg ostroma) or siege of Güns (Turkish: Güns Kuşatması), also known as the German campaign (Turkish: Alman Seferi) was a siege of Kőszeg (German: Güns) in the Western Kingdom of Hungary which ruled by Ferdinand I, a Habsburg king, that took place in 1532.

zh.s: 科塞格围城战又称居恩斯围城战，也称“德意志战役”，发生于1532年。斐迪南一世统治的匈牙利西部王国境内，哈布斯堡军队围攻科塞格（德语名：居恩斯）。匈牙利语称“Kőszeg ostroma”，土耳其语称“Güns Kuşatması”或“Alman Seferi”。

en.t: With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Church for approving the Acts of Supremacy, although the bull is likely never published
en.s: The Acts of Supremacy are two acts passed by the Parliament of England in the 16th century that established the English monarchs as the head of the Church of England; two similar laws were passed by the Parliament of Ireland establishing the English monarchs as the head of the Church of Ireland. The 1534 act declared King Henry VIII and his successors as the Supreme Head of the Church, replacing the Pope.

zh.t: 教宗保禄三世颁布《Eius qui immobilis》教宗诏书，将批准《至尊法案》的英格兰国王亨利八世逐出天主教会，但该诏书很可能从未发布
zh.s: 《至尊法案》是英格兰议会在16世纪通过的两项法案，确立英格兰君主为英格兰教会首脑；爱尔兰议会也通过了两项类似法律，确立英格兰君主为爱尔兰教会首脑。1534年法案宣布国王亨利八世及其继承人为教会最高领袖，取代教宗。

en.s: The siege of Paris (7 May – 30 August 1590) took place during the French Wars of Religion when the French Royal Army under Henry of Navarre, and supported by the Huguenots, failed to capture the city of Paris from the Catholic League. Paris was finally relieved from the siege by an international Catholic-Spanish army under the command of Alexander Farnese, Duke of Parma.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴黎围城战发生于1590年5月7日至8月30日，是法国宗教战争期间的一场围城战。纳瓦拉的亨利率领法国王军，在胡格诺派支持下，未能从天主教联盟手中攻下巴黎。帕尔马公爵亚历山大·法尔内塞率领一支由多个国家组成的天主教—西班牙联军，最终解除了围城。

en.t: King James VI of Scotland holds a masque at the baptism of Prince Henry at Stirling Castle
en.s: James VI and I (James Charles Stuart; 19 June 1566 – 27 March 1625) was King of Scotland as James VI from 24 July 1567, and King of England and Ireland as James I from the union of the Scottish and English crowns on 24 March 1603, until his death in 1625.

zh.t: 苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世在斯特灵城堡为亨利王子的洗礼举办假面舞会
zh.s: 詹姆斯六世及一世（詹姆斯·查尔斯·斯图亚特；1566年6月19日—1625年3月27日）自1567年7月24日起担任苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世；1603年3月24日苏格兰与英格兰王冠合并后，他又担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王詹姆斯一世，直至1625年去世。

en.s: The Palatinate campaign (30 August 1620 – 27 August 1623), also known as the Spanish conquest of the Palatinate or the Palatinate phase of the Thirty Years' War, was a campaign conducted by the Imperial army of the Holy Roman Empire against the Protestant Union in the Lower Palatinate, during the Thirty Years' War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 普法尔茨战役（1620年8月30日至1623年8月27日）又称西班牙征服普法尔茨，或三十年战争中的普法尔茨阶段。这是三十年战争期间，神圣罗马帝国皇帝军队在下普法尔茨对抗新教联盟的一场战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Batočina (Serbian: Битка код Баточине) was fought on 29–30 August 1689 near the town of Batočina in the Sanjak of Smederevo (now in central Serbia), between forces of the Holy Roman Empire and the Ottoman Empire during the Great Turkish War (1683–1699). The Serbian Militia under the command of Pavle Nestorović as a vanguard unit of the Habsburg army was victorious against a vanguard unit of the Ottoman army during the battle.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴托奇纳战役（塞尔维亚语：Битка код Баточине）于1689年8月29日至30日在斯梅代雷沃桑扎克（今塞尔维亚中部）的巴托奇纳附近进行。神圣罗马帝国与奥斯曼帝国在大土耳其战争（1683—1699年）期间交战。帕夫莱·内斯托罗维奇指挥的塞尔维亚民兵作为哈布斯堡军队的先锋，击败了奥斯曼军队的先锋部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Treaty of Nystad, or the Treaty of Uusikaupunki, was the last peace treaty of the Great Northern War of 1700–1721. It was concluded between the Tsardom of Russia and the Swedish Empire on 10 September [O.S. 30 August] 1721 in the then Swedish town of Nystad (Uusikaupunki, in the south-west of present-day Finland). Sweden had settled with the other parties in Stockholm (1719 and 1720) and in Frederiksborg (1720).
en.n: The Great Northern War between Sweden and Russia ends in the Treaty of Nystad.

zh.s: 尼斯塔德条约又称乌西考蓬基条约，是1700年至1721年大北方战争的最后一份和约。1721年9月10日（儒略历8月30日），俄罗斯沙皇国与瑞典帝国在当时属于瑞典的尼斯塔德（今芬兰西南部乌西考蓬基）缔结条约。瑞典此前已分别于1719年、1720年在斯德哥尔摩，以及1720年在弗雷德里克斯堡与其他交战方议和。
zh.n: 瑞典与俄罗斯的大北方战争以《尼斯塔德条约》结束。

en.s: The Battle of Gross Jägersdorf (Gross-Jägersdorf; 30 August 1757) was a victory for the Russian force under Field Marshal Stepan Fyodorovich Apraksin over a smaller Prussian force commanded by Field Marshal Hans von Lehwaldt, during the Seven Years' War. This was the first battle in which Russia engaged during the Seven Years' War. Despite the tactical success, supply problems made a successful advance further into East Prussia impractical.

zh.t: 格罗斯-耶格斯多夫战役
zh.s: 1757年8月30日，七年战争期间，斯捷潘·费奥多罗维奇·阿普拉克辛元帅率领的俄军击败了由汉斯·冯·莱瓦尔德元帅指挥、规模较小的普军。这是俄国在七年战争中参加的第一场战役。虽然俄军取得战术胜利，但补给问题使其无法有效向东普鲁士继续推进。

en.s: The Battle of Nauheim (also known as the Battle of the Johannisberg or Johannesberg) took place during the Seven Years' War near Bad Nauheim in the Landgraviate of Hessen-Kassel on 30 August 1762. French troops under the command of Louis Joseph, Prince of Condé defeated Hanoverian and British troops under the command of Duke Ferdinand of Brunswick.

zh.s: 1762年8月30日，七年战争期间，法国军队在黑森-卡塞尔伯国巴特瑙海姆附近与汉诺威和英国联军交战。孔代亲王路易·约瑟夫率领的法军击败了不伦瑞克公爵斐迪南指挥的联军。这场战役也称约翰尼斯贝格战役。

en.s: In the Vlieter incident of 30 August 1799 a Batavian Navy fleet under Schout-bij-nacht Samuel Story surrendered to the Royal Navy. The incident occurred during the Anglo-Russian invasion of Holland in the tidal trench between Texel and the mainland that was known as De Vlieter, near Wieringen.

zh.s: 1799年8月30日，萨缪尔·斯托里少将率领的巴达维亚海军舰队向英国皇家海军投降，这一事件称为弗利特事件。事件发生在英俄入侵荷兰期间，地点是特塞尔岛与荷兰大陆之间、魏灵根附近名为“德弗利特”的潮汐水道。

en.s: Gabriel's Rebellion was a planned slave rebellion in the Richmond, Virginia, area in the summer of 1800. Information regarding the revolt was leaked before its execution, and Gabriel, an enslaved blacksmith who planned the event, and twenty-five of his followers were hanged. Gabriel's planned uprising was notable not because of its results—the rebellion was quelled before it could begin—but because of its potential for mass chaos and widespread violence.

zh.s: 加百列起义是1800年夏季在弗吉尼亚州里士满地区策划的一场奴隶起义。起义计划在实施前泄露；策划行动的被奴役黑人铁匠加百列及其25名追随者被绞死。加百列起义计划的意义不在于结果——起义尚未开始便遭镇压——而在于它可能引发大规模混乱和广泛暴力。

en.s: The Janissary revolt in Tunisia took place on 30 August 1811 and pitted the Janissaries — Turkish militias — against the forces of the Beylik of Tunis.

en.s: The Battle at Fort Mims occurred on 30 August 1813 during the Creek War, when a force of Creek Indians, belonging to the "Red Sticks" faction under the command of head warriors Peter McQueen and William Weatherford, or Lamochattee (Red Eagle), stormed the fort and defeated the militia garrison. After the defeat of the garrison there ensued a massacre and almost all of the remaining Lower Creek, white settlers, and militia at Fort Mims were killed. The fort was a stockade with a blockhouse surrounding the house and outbuildings of the settler Samuel Mims, located about 35 miles north of present-day Mobile, Alabama.

zh.s: 1813年8月30日，克里克战争期间，克里克人红棒派的首领彼得·麦奎因和威廉·韦瑟福德（又名红鹰）率军进攻米姆斯堡，击败了守军民兵。守军落败后发生屠杀，堡内几乎所有剩余的下克里克人、白人定居者和民兵都被杀。米姆斯堡是一座木栅堡垒，围住定居者塞缪尔·米姆斯的住宅和附属建筑，位于今阿拉巴马州莫比尔以北约35英里。

en.s: Melbourne ( MEL-bərn, locally [ˈmæɫbən] ) is the capital and most populous city of the Australian state of Victoria and the second-most populous city in Australia. The city's name generally refers to a 9,993-square-kilometre (3,858 sq mi) area, comprising an urban agglomeration of 30 local government areas. The name is also used specifically to refer to the local government area, also named the City of Melbourne, whose administrative area is centred on the Melbourne central business district and some immediate surrounds.

zh.t: 澳大利亚：维多利亚州墨尔本建城
zh.s: 墨尔本（当地读作[ˈmæɫbən]）是澳大利亚维多利亚州首府和人口最多的城市，也是澳大利亚人口第二多的城市。该市名称通常指面积9,993平方公里（3,858平方英里）的区域，由30个地方政府区域组成的城市群构成。这个名称也特指墨尔本市地方政府区域，其行政范围以墨尔本中央商务区及附近地区为中心。

en.t: The city of Houston is founded by Augustus Chapman Allen and John Kirby Allen
en.s: Houston ( HEW-stən) is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Texas and the Southern United States. It is the fourth-most populous city in the United States, with a population of 2.3 million at the 2020 census. The Greater Houston metropolitan area, at 7.8 million residents, is the fifth-most populous metropolitan area in the nation and second-most populous in Texas.

zh.t: 奥古斯塔斯·查普曼·艾伦和约翰·柯比·艾伦创建休斯敦市
zh.s: 休斯敦（读作HEW-stən）是美国得克萨斯州和美国南部人口最多的城市。它是美国人口第四多的城市，2020年人口普查时人口为230万。大休斯敦大都会区人口780万，是全美人口第五多、得克萨斯州人口第二多的大都会区。

en.s: The Battle of Osawatomie was an armed engagement that occurred on August 30, 1856, when 250–400 pro-slavery Border ruffians, led by John W. Reid, attacked the town of Osawatomie, Kansas, which had been settled largely by anti-slavery Free-Staters. Reid was intent on destroying the Free-State settlement and then moving on to Topeka and Lawrence to do more of the same.

zh.s: 1856年8月30日，奥萨瓦托米发生武装冲突。约250至400名支持奴隶制的边境暴徒在约翰·W·里德带领下，袭击了堪萨斯州奥萨瓦托米镇。当地居民主要支持废奴和堪萨斯建州。里德意图摧毁这个自由州据点，然后继续袭击托皮卡和劳伦斯。

en.s: The Battle of Richmond, Kentucky, fought August 29–30, 1862, was one of the most complete Confederate victories in the American Civil War by Major General Edmund Kirby Smith against Union major general William "Bull" Nelson's forces, which were defending the town. It was the first major battle in the Kentucky Campaign. The battle took place on and around what is now the grounds of the Blue Grass Army Depot, outside Richmond, Kentucky.
en.n: American Civil War: Battle of Richmond: Confederates under Edmund Kirby Smith rout Union forces under General William "Bull" Nelson.

zh.s: 肯塔基州里士满战役发生于1862年8月29日至30日，是美国内战中南方邦联军取得的最彻底胜利之一。南军由埃德蒙·柯比·史密斯少将指挥，击败了守卫该镇、由威廉·“斗牛”·纳尔逊少将指挥的联邦军。这是肯塔基战役中的首场重要战役，战场位于今肯塔基州里士满城外、蓝草陆军仓库现址及其周边。
zh.n: 美国内战：里士满战役中，埃德蒙·柯比·史密斯率领的南军击溃威廉·“斗牛”·纳尔逊将军指挥的联邦军。

en.s: The Battle of Beaumont on 30 August 1870 was won by Prussia during the Franco-Prussian War. It was fought between Fifth French Corps d'Armee under General Pierre Louis Charles de Failly, and the IV and XII (Royal Saxon) Army Corps under Prince George of Saxony (the XII Army Corps was all-Saxon, while the IV Army Corps was a mix of regiments from Anhalt, Prussian Saxony and the Thuringian states) along with the I Royal Bavarian Corps under general Ludwig Freiherr von der Tann. The French were surprised in their cantonments and driven back upon Mouzon, with losses of 4,800 men and 42 guns to the Germans' 3,500.

zh.s: 1870年8月30日，普鲁士在普法战争中的博蒙战役获胜。法军第五军由皮埃尔·路易·夏尔·德·费伊将军指挥；普军一方包括萨克森王子乔治率领的第四军和第十二军（第十二军全由萨克森人组成，第四军则由安哈尔特、普鲁士萨克森和图林根诸邦的部队混编），以及路德维希·冯·德·坦恩将军率领的巴伐利亚第一军。法军在驻地遭到突袭，被击退至穆宗；法军损失4800人和42门火炮，德军损失3500人。

en.s: The Battle of Orihuela took place in Spain on August 30, 1873, between the forces of the Canton of Cartagena, led by Antonio Gálvez, and the government forces, led by the military governor Ruiz Piñero and Mariano Artés Campillo. The fight ended with victory for the cantonalists and resulted in Orihuela's adherence to the revolutionary cause.

zh.s: 1873年8月30日，卡塔赫纳自治派由安东尼奥·加尔维斯率领，在西班牙奥里韦拉与政府军交战。政府军由军事总督鲁伊斯·皮涅罗和马里亚诺·阿尔特斯·坎皮略指挥。战斗以自治派获胜告终，奥里韦拉随后加入革命阵营。

en.s: The Jowaki Expedition was a British punitive expedition in India, occurring between 1877 and 1878. It started when the British government in India proposed to reduce the payment of the Jowaki Afridi tribe in the Northwest Frontier. The Jowaki were paid to guard in the Kohat Pass and in retaliation for a reduction in payment they raided British territory. The expedition ended in January 1878 when tensions died down.

en.s: The Battle of Cibecue Creek was an engagement of the Apache Wars, fought in August 1881 between the United States and White Mountain Apaches in Arizona, at Cibecue Creek on the Fort Apache Indian Reservation. After an army expedition of scouts, U.S. Army soldiers 'arrested' a prominent Cibecue Apache medicine man named Nock-ay-det-klinne. The U.S. Army soldiers were taking Nock-ay-det-klinné back to the fort when they were ambushed by Apache warriors.

zh.s: 锡贝丘溪战役是阿帕奇战争中的一次交战，于1881年8月在亚利桑那州的锡贝丘溪、阿帕奇堡印第安保留地发生。一次由侦察兵组成的远征结束后，美军士兵“逮捕”了锡贝丘阿帕奇族一位颇有影响力的巫医诺克艾德克利内。士兵正将他押回堡垒时，遭到白山阿帕奇族战士伏击。

en.t: Battle of San Juan del Monte
en.s: The Battle of San Juan del Monte, took place on 30 August 1896. It is considered the first real battle of the Philippine revolution, which sought Philippine independence from Spain. The first battle cry of the Katipunan coincided with the pealing of the church bell at nine on the night of August 29, 1896.

zh.s: 圣胡安德尔蒙特战役发生于1896年8月30日。它被视为菲律宾革命中的第一场真正战役；这场革命旨在争取菲律宾脱离西班牙独立。8月29日晚上9点，卡蒂普南组织的第一声战斗号角与教堂钟声同时响起。

en.s: The Battle of Noveleta known as Battle of Calero Bridge was a major battle during the Philippine revolution and was one of the first engagements of the revolution in Cavite. In the latter part of the revolution, Noveleta played a key role for the Magdalo and Magdiwang factions. From its capture by the Magdiwang at the start of the revolution, various battles were fought and won by Filipino rebels in Cavite.

zh.s: 诺韦莱塔战役又称卡莱罗桥战役，是菲律宾革命期间的一场重要战斗，也是革命军在甲米地的首批交战之一。革命后期，诺韦莱塔成为马格达洛派和马格迪旺派的重要据点。革命初期马格迪旺派攻占该地后，菲律宾叛军在甲米地多次作战并取得胜利。

en.s: The siege of Santa Cruz was launched by Filipino forces led by General Paciano Rizal, brother of political activist and writer Jose Rizal against a Spanish garrison in Santa Cruz, Laguna, Philippines. The siege took place until the garrison finally surrendered to the besieging Filipino force. It took place between 24 June and 30 August 1898, during the waning days of the Philippine Revolution.

zh.s: 政治活动家兼作家何塞·黎刹的兄弟帕西亚诺·黎刹将军率领菲律宾军队围攻菲律宾拉古纳省圣克鲁斯的一支西班牙守军。围城持续至守军最终向围城部队投降。这场围城战发生于1898年6月24日至8月30日，正值菲律宾革命后期。

en.s: The 1905 Copa de Honor Municipalidad de Buenos Aires was the final that decided the champion of the first edition of this National cup of Argentina. In the match, held in Sociedad Sportiva Argentina, Alumni defeated Quilmes 1–0 in extra time, becoming the first winner of this competition.

en.s: The 1906 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 4th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. For the fifth time since 1900, there were two Argentine teams in the final, Alumni and Belgrano A.C., both from the Belgrano neighborhood, that also had a strong rivalry. The match was held in the former Guido y Sarmiento Stadium of Quilmes Atlético Club on 30 August 1906.

zh.s: 1906年Tie杯决赛是决出Tie杯冠军的最后一场比赛；该赛事由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同主办，这是第4届。自1900年以来，这是第5次由两支阿根廷球队参加决赛，参赛队是阿尔米兰特和贝尔格拉诺A.C.，两队都来自贝尔格拉诺区，彼此竞争激烈。比赛于1906年8月30日在基尔梅斯竞技俱乐部原吉多与萨米恩托球场举行。

en.t: Burgess Shale fossils are discovered by Charles Doolittle Walcott
en.s: The Burgess Shale is a fossil-bearing deposit exposed in the Canadian Rockies of British Columbia, Canada. It is famous for the exceptional preservation of the soft parts of its fossils. At c.505 million years old (middle Cambrian), it is one of the earliest fossil beds containing soft-part imprints. The rock unit is a black shale and crops out at several localities near the town of Field in Yoho National Park and the Kicking Horse Pass.

zh.t: 查尔斯·杜利特尔·沃尔科特发现伯吉斯页岩化石
zh.s: 伯吉斯页岩是位于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省加拿大落基山脉的一处含化石地层，以化石软体部分保存异常完好而闻名。该地层距今约5.05亿年，属于寒武纪中期，是最早保存软体印痕的化石层之一。岩层为黑色页岩，在幽鹤国家公园菲尔德镇附近和踢马山口一带的多个地点露出地表。

en.s: The Battle of Tannenberg, also known as the Second Battle of Tannenberg, was fought between Russia and Germany between 26 and 30 August 1914, the first month of World War I. The battle resulted in the encirclement and the almost complete destruction of the Russian 2nd Army by the German 8th Army and the suicide of its commanding general, Alexander Samsonov. A series of follow-up battles (First Masurian Lakes) led to the ousting of the Russian 1st Army from East Prussia. The outcome brought considerable prestige to the German army commander, General Paul von Hindenburg, and his rising staff officer, General Erich Ludendorff.

zh.s: 坦能堡战役又称第二次坦能堡战役，是第一次世界大战爆发第一个月内的一场战役，于1914年8月26日至30日在俄德两军之间进行。德军第八集团军包围并几乎全歼俄军第二集团军，其司令亚历山大·萨姆索诺夫随后自杀。之后的一系列战斗（第一次马祖里湖战役）迫使俄军第一集团军撤出东普鲁士。这场战役使德军指挥官保罗·冯·兴登堡将军及其逐渐崭露头角的参谋埃里希·鲁登道夫声望大增。

en.s: The Battle of Dumlupınar (Greek: Μάχη του Τουμλού Μπουνάρ, romanized: Máchi tou Toumloú Bounár, Turkish: Dumlupınar (Meydan) Muharebesi, lit. en.s: The Second Vienna Award was the second of two territorial disputes that were arbitrated by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. en.s: The Tighina Agreement (Romanian: Acordul de la Tighina; German: Tighiner Abkommen) was an agreement between Nazi Germany and Romania about administration, economy and security issues of the Transnistria Governorate that entered into force on 30 August 1941. It was signed during World War II, while the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union was taking place. The Tiraspol Agreement through which Romania received the region had entered in force shortly before, on 19 August.

zh.s: 蒂希纳协定（罗马尼亚语：Acordul de la Tighina；德语：Tighiner Abkommen）是纳粹德国与罗马尼亚就德涅斯特河沿岸省的行政、经济和安全事务达成的协议，于1941年8月30日生效。协定签署时正值第二次世界大战期间轴心国入侵苏联。罗马尼亚取得该地区所依据的《蒂拉斯波尔协定》已于此前不久的8月19日生效。

Panzerarmee Afrika (Generalfeldmarschall Erwin Rommel), attempted an envelopment of the British Eighth Army (Lieutenant-General Bernard Montgomery). In Unternehmen Brandung (Operation Surf), the last big Axis offensive of the Western Desert Campaign, Rommel intended to defeat the Eighth Army before Allied reinforcements arrived.

en.s: On 30 August 1974, the Mitsubishi Heavy Industries headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, was bombed, killing eight people and injuring at least 376 others. The bombing was committed by the East Asia Anti-Japan Armed Front, a far-left, anti-Japanese militant organization, against Mitsubishi Heavy Industries for supplying the United States Armed Forces during the Vietnam War. It was the deadliest terrorist attack in Japan until the Tokyo subway sarin attack in 1995.

zh.s: 1974年8月30日，三菱重工业位于日本东京的总部遭到炸弹袭击，造成8人死亡，至少376人受伤。袭击由极左反日组织“东亚反日武装战线”实施，目标是三菱重工业向越南战争中的美国武装部队供货。直到1995年东京地铁沙林毒气袭击发生前，这是日本伤亡最惨重的恐怖袭击。

en.s: The Zagreb train disaster occurred on 30 August 1974 when an express train (number 10410) traveling from Belgrade, Yugoslavia, to Dortmund, West Germany, derailed before entering Zagreb Main Station (Croatia), killing 153 people. It was the worst rail accident in Yugoslavia's history and remains one of the worst in Europe's history.

zh.s: 1974年8月30日，一列编号为10410的特快列车从南斯拉夫贝尔格莱德驶往西德多特蒙德，在进入克罗地亚萨格勒布中央车站前脱轨，造成153人死亡。这是南斯拉夫历史上最严重的铁路事故，至今仍是欧洲最严重的铁路事故之一。

en.t: The Third World Population Conference ends in Bucharest, Romania. At the end of the ceremony, the UN-Romanian Demographic Centre is inaugurated
en.s: The first ever World Population Conference was held at the Salle Centrale, Geneva, Switzerland, from 29 August to 3 September 1927. Organized by the forerunner of the United Nations, the League of Nations, and Margaret Sanger; the conference was an attempt to bring together international experts on population, food supply, fertility, migration and health to discuss the problem of human overpopulation.

zh.t: 第三届世界人口会议在罗马尼亚布加勒斯特闭幕，闭幕仪式上联合国—罗马尼亚人口中心揭幕
zh.s: 首届世界人口会议于1927年8月29日至9月3日在瑞士日内瓦中央会堂举行。会议由联合国前身国际联盟和玛格丽特·桑格组织，旨在汇集人口、粮食供应、生育、移民和健康领域的国际专家，讨论人口过剩问题。

en.s: The 1980 Israel Super Cup was the tenth Israel Super Cup (15th, including unofficial matches, as the competition wasn't played within the Israel Football Association in its first 5 editions, until 1969), an annual Israel football match played between the winners of the previous season's Top Division and Israel State Cup. The match was played between Maccabi Netanya, champions of the 1979–80 Liga Leumit and Hapoel Kfar Saba, winners of the 1979–80 Israel State Cup.

zh.s: 1980年以色列超级杯是该项赛事的第10届；若计入赛事创办初期未纳入以色列足协体系的五届非正式比赛，则为第15届（赛事直到1969年才纳入足协体系）。这是一年一度的以色列足球比赛，由上赛季顶级联赛冠军对阵以色列国家杯冠军。本场比赛由1979—80赛季以色列顶级联赛冠军内坦亚马卡比对阵1979—80赛季以色列国家杯冠军卡法萨巴工人队。

en.s: Mohammad-Javad Bahonar (Persian: محمدجواد باهنر‎, 5 September 1933 – 30 August 1981) was an Iranian theologian and politician who served as the Prime Minister of Iran for less than one month, in August 1981. On 30 August, Bahonar and other members of Mohammad-Ali Rajai's government were assassinated by Mujahideen-e Khalq.

zh.t: 伊朗总统拉贾伊和总理巴霍纳尔遭炸弹袭击身亡
zh.s: 穆罕默德·贾瓦德·巴霍纳尔（波斯语：محمدجواد باهنر‎，1933年9月5日—1981年8月30日）是伊朗神学家和政治家，曾于1981年8月担任总理，不到一个月。8月30日，巴霍纳尔和总统穆罕默德·阿里·拉贾伊政府的其他成员遭伊朗人民圣战者组织暗杀。

en.s: 1982 JSL Cup final was the seventh final of the JSL Cup competition. The final was played at Kusanagi Athletic Stadium in Shizuoka on August 30, 1982. Furukawa Electric won the championship.

zh.s: 1982年日本足球联赛杯决赛是该赛事的第7场决赛，于1982年8月30日在静冈的草薙综合运动场举行。古河电工队夺得冠军。

en.s: STS-8 was the eighth NASA Space Shuttle mission and the third flight of the Space Shuttle Challenger. It launched on August 30, 1983, and landed on September 5, 1983, conducting the first night launch and night landing of the Space Shuttle program. It also carried the first African-American astronaut to go into space, Guion Bluford.

zh.s: STS-8是NASA第八次航天飞机任务，也是“挑战者号”航天飞机的第三次飞行。航天飞机于1983年8月30日发射，并于9月5日着陆，完成了航天飞机计划的首次夜间发射和夜间着陆。机上还搭载了首位进入太空的非裔美国宇航员吉恩·布鲁福德。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 5463 was a Soviet domestic passenger flight from Chelyabinsk to Almaty which crashed on 30 August 1983 while approaching Almaty. The Tupolev Tu-134A collided with the western slope of Dolan Mountain at an altitude of 690 m (2,260 ft). As a result of the accident, all ninety people on board were killed. Crew error was cited as the cause of the accident.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空5463号班机空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空5463号班机是从车里雅宾斯克飞往阿拉木图的苏联国内客运航班，1983年8月30日在接近阿拉木图时坠毁。图-134A客机在690米（2,260英尺）高度撞上多兰山西坡。机上90人全部遇难。事故原因被认定为机组人员失误。

en.s: STS-41-D (formerly STS-14) was the 12th flight of NASA's Space Shuttle program, and the maiden flight of Space Shuttle Discovery. It was launched from Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on August 30, 1984, and landed at Edwards Air Force Base, California, on September 5, 1984.

zh.s: STS-41-D（原编号STS-14）是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）航天飞机计划的第12次飞行，也是“发现号”航天飞机的首次飞行。航天飞机于1984年8月30日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射，并于1984年9月5日在加利福尼亚州爱德华兹空军基地着陆。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Singapore on 30 August 1985, following the resignation of the incumbent, Devan Nair. During the election, 73 members of Parliament were present and five members were absent. Wee Kim Wee was elected by the Parliament of Singapore. Wee was sworn in as the fourth president on 2 September 1985.

zh.s: 新加坡于1985年8月30日举行间接总统选举，时任总统蒂凡那已辞职。投票时有73名议员出席，5名缺席。黄金辉由新加坡国会选出，并于1985年9月2日宣誓就任第四任总统。

en.s: The 1986 Batang Ai by-election is a by-election for the Sarawak State Legislative Assembly state seat of Batang Ai, Malaysia that were held on 29 and 30 August 1986. It was called following the death of the incumbent, Sylvester Langit on 1 June 1986.

zh.s: 马来西亚砂拉越州议会峇当艾选区于1986年8月29日至30日举行补选。在任议员西尔维斯特·兰吉特于同年6月1日去世，此次补选因此举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Mauritius on 30 August 1987. The result was a victory for the Alliance, composed of the Labour Party, the Mauritian Socialist Movement and the Mauritian Social Democrat Party, which won 44 of the 70 seats. The voting system involved twenty constituencies on Mauritius, which each elected three members. Two seats were elected by residents of Rodrigues, and up to eight seats were filled by the "best losers".

zh.s: 毛里求斯于1987年8月30日举行大选。由工党、毛里求斯社会主义运动和毛里求斯社会民主党组成的联盟获胜，赢得70席中的44席。选举制度在毛里求斯本岛设20个选区，每区选出3名议员；罗德里格斯岛居民选出2名议员，另有最多8席按“最佳落选者”制度分配。

en.s: Ambush at Drumnakilly is an Irish rebel song about an event in County Tyrone, Northern Ireland which occurred on August 30, 1988: three volunteers of the Provisional IRA (IRA), brothers Martin and Gerard Harte and Brian Mullin (Bard), were ambushed and killed by the Special Air Service (SAS). The IRA members were attempting to murder a previously identified off-duty member of the Ulster Defence Regiment who seemed to be fixing a tyre on a coal lorry. The IRA unit drove up, armed with two AK-47 rifles and a revolver, and were ambushed as they approached by a dozen undercover soldiers, with others manning a heavy machine gun in a nearby derelict building.

zh.t: 德鲁姆纳基利伏击事件
zh.s: 《德鲁姆纳基利伏击事件》是一首爱尔兰反叛歌曲，写的是1988年8月30日发生在北爱尔兰蒂龙郡的事件：临时爱尔兰共和军（IRA）的三名成员——兄弟马丁·哈特、杰拉德·哈特和布赖恩·穆林（又名巴德）——遭英国特种空勤团（SAS）伏击身亡。当时，这支IRA小队正试图杀害一名此前已被他们盯上的阿尔斯特防卫团成员；此人当时已下班，似乎正在给一辆运煤卡车换轮胎。小队开车接近时携带两支AK-47步枪和一把左轮手枪，埋伏在附近的十多名秘密行动士兵随即发动袭击，另有士兵在附近一栋废弃建筑中操作一挺重机枪。

en.s: The 1989 Greek Super Cup was the 4th edition of the Greek Super Cup, an association football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Alpha Ethniki and Greek Cup competitions. The match took place on 30 August 1989 at the Athens Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were the 1988–89 Alpha Ethniki champions, AEK Athens and the 1988–89 Greek Cup winners, Panathinaikos.

zh.s: 1989年希腊超级杯是第4届希腊超级杯，由上赛季希腊甲级联赛和希腊杯冠军交锋。比赛于1989年8月30日在雅典奥林匹克体育场举行，参赛球队是1988—89赛季希腊甲级联赛冠军雅典AEK和希腊杯冠军帕纳辛奈科斯。

en.s: Tatarstan, officially the Republic of Tatarstan, sometimes also called Tataria, is a republic of Russia located in Eastern Europe. It is a part of the Volga Federal District; and its capital and largest city is Kazan, an important cultural centre in Russia. The region's main source of wealth is oil with a strong petrochemical industry.

zh.s: 鞑靼斯坦，正式名称为鞑靼斯坦共和国，有时也称鞑靼利亚，是俄罗斯位于东欧的一个共和国，属于伏尔加联邦管区。首府和最大城市是喀山，也是俄罗斯重要的文化中心。当地主要财富来源是石油，并拥有发达的石油化工业。

en.s: The 1992 New Territories West by-election was held on 30 August 1992 after the incumbent Legislative Councillor Ng Ming-yam of New Territories West died of blood cancer on 22 June 1992. It was the second by-election in the constituency since the 1991 general election. The two-time candidate, conservative rural leader Tang Siu-tong defeated Albert Ho Chun-yan, vice chairman of the liberal United Democrats of Hong Kong (UDHK), and independent Sui See-chun with 51 percent majority, receiving 33,038 votes.

zh.s: 1992年新界西补选于1992年8月30日举行，起因是新界西选区立法局议员吴明钦于同年6月22日因血癌去世。这是1991年大选以来该选区的第二次补选。曾两次参选的保守派乡事领袖邓兆棠击败自由派香港民主同盟（UDHK）副主席何俊仁和独立候选人徐四俊，以多数票51%的支持率当选，获得33,038票。

en.s: The 1992 Supercoppa Italiana was a match played by the 1991–92 Serie A winners AC Milan and 1991–92 Coppa Italia winners Parma. It took place on 30 August 1992 at the San Siro in Milan, Italy. AC Milan won the match 2–1 to earn their second Supercoppa.

zh.s: 1992年意大利超级杯由1991—92赛季意甲冠军AC米兰对阵意大利杯冠军帕尔马，于1992年8月30日在意大利米兰的圣西罗球场举行。AC米兰以2比1获胜，第二次夺得超级杯。

en.t: 1993 Philippine House of Representatives special elections
en.s: Two special elections (known as "by-elections" elsewhere) to the House of Representatives of the Philippines, the lower house of Congress, were held on August 30, 1993. These were vacancies in the 9th Congress; the winners were to serve the rest of the term, which had ended on June 30, 1995. These were the first special elections since the preceding ones in 1967, the downfall of Ferdinand Marcos in 1986, and the approval of the 1987 constitution.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1993年8月30日举行两场众议院特别选举。菲律宾众议院是国会下院；此次选举是为填补第九届国会中的空缺，胜选者将完成截至1995年6月30日的剩余任期。这是自1967年上次特别选举以来的首次特别选举，发生在费迪南德·马科斯于1986年倒台、1987年宪法获批之后。

en.s: The 1993 SummerSlam was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the sixth annual SummerSlam and took place on Monday, August 30, 1993, at The Palace of Auburn Hills in Auburn Hills, Michigan and featured 10 televised matches. All three of the WWF's then-active championships were defended at the event.

zh.s: 1993年夏日狂潮大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF，现为WWE）举办的付费赛事，也是第6届夏日狂潮大赛，于1993年8月30日星期一在密歇根州奥本希尔斯的宫殿体育馆举行，电视转播了10场比赛。WWF当时设立的3项冠军头衔都在赛事中接受了挑战。

en.s: Operation Deliberate Force was a sustained air campaign conducted by NATO, in concert with the UNPROFOR ground operations, to undermine the military capability of the Army of Republika Srpska (VRS), which had threatened and attacked UN-designated "safe areas" in Bosnia and Herzegovina during the Bosnian War, with the Srebrenica genocide and Markale massacres precipitating the intervention.

en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory on Saturday August 30, 1997, and was won by the incumbent Country Liberal Party (CLP). Shane Stone continued as Chief Minister. During the previous term, the CLP had lost the seat of Fannie Bay to Labor in a by-election. The CLP did not win the seat back, but managed to take MacDonnell from Labor and Nelson after Independent Noel Padgham-Purich retired.

zh.s: 北领地于1997年8月30日星期六举行大选，现任乡村自由党（CLP）获胜，肖恩·斯通继续担任首席部长。上一届任期内，CLP在一次补选中将芬妮湾选区输给工党。CLP未能夺回该席，但在独立议员诺埃尔·帕德汉姆-珀里奇退休后，从工党手中赢得麦克唐奈尔选区和纳尔逊选区。

en.s: SummerSlam (1998) was the eleventh annual SummerSlam professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF), and the fourth presented by Stridex. It took place on August 30, 1998, at Madison Square Garden in New York City, New York. The main event a Singles match for the WWF Championship between Stone Cold Steve Austin and The Undertaker. Austin won the match via pinfall after a Stunner to retain the WWF Championship. The main match on the undercard featured a ladder match for the WWF Intercontinental Championship between Triple H and The Rock, which Triple H won to win the Intercontinental Championship.

zh.s: 1998年夏日狂潮大赛是世界摔角联盟（WWF）举办的第11届年度夏日狂潮付费赛事，也是由Stridex赞助的第4届赛事。比赛于1998年8月30日在纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行。主赛是WWF冠军单打赛，由“冷石”史蒂夫·奥斯汀对阵送葬者；奥斯汀用“断头台”招式压制对手获胜，保住冠军头衔。另一场重点比赛是WWF洲际冠军梯子赛，由Triple H对阵巨石强森，Triple H获胜并夺得洲际冠军。

en.s: Operation Kitona was a Rwandan/Ugandan offensive that marked the beginning of the Second Congo War. Rwanda hoped to depose Laurent-Désiré Kabila and install a government more favorable to Rwanda's interests by quickly taking control of Kinshasa and the strategic western province of Bas-Congo (today Kongo Central). On August 4, 1998, joint Rwandan and Ugandan forces launched a surprise attack on Kitona airbase in Western Congo using hijacked civilian airliners.

zh.s: 基托纳行动是卢旺达和乌干达发动的一次攻势，标志着第二次刚果战争开始。卢旺达希望迅速控制金沙萨及具有战略意义的刚果西部省份下刚果（今刚果中央省），推翻洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉，并扶植一个更符合卢旺达利益的政府。1998年8月4日，卢旺达和乌干达联军劫持民航客机，突然袭击刚果西部的基托纳空军基地。

en.s: Rico Linhas Aéreas Flight 4823 was a short haul domestic Brazilian flight from Cruzeiro do Sul and Tarauacá to Rio Branco. On 30 August 2002, the Embraer EMB 120 Brasilia, registration PT-WRQ, flying the route crashed in heavy rain. Of the 31 aboard, 23 were killed, including all three crew members, and 20 of the 28 passengers.

zh.s: Rico Linhas Aéreas 4823号班机是巴西一条短程国内航线，从克鲁塞罗杜苏尔和塔劳阿卡飞往里奥布朗库。2002年8月30日，这架注册编号为PT-WRQ的巴西航空工业EMB 120“巴西利亚”客机在暴雨中飞行该航线时坠毁。机上31人中有23人遇难，其中包括全部3名机组人员和28名乘客中的20人。

en.s: The 2002 Iraqi Perseverance Cup (Arabic: كأس المثابرة العراقي 2002) was the 7th edition of the Iraqi Super Cup. The match was contested between Baghdad rivals Al-Talaba and Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya at Al-Shaab Stadium in Baghdad. It was played on 30 August 2002 as a curtain-raiser to the 2002–03 season. Al-Talaba won their first Super Cup title, winning the match 2–1 after golden goal extra time.

zh.s: 2002年伊拉克坚持杯（阿拉伯语：كأس المثابرة العراقي 2002）是第7届伊拉克超级杯。比赛于2002年8月30日在巴格达的沙阿卜体育场举行，由巴格达两支球队塔拉巴和空军队对阵，作为2002—03赛季的揭幕战。塔拉巴在金球制加时赛中以2比1获胜，首次夺得超级杯。

en.s: The 2002 UEFA Super Cup was played on 30 August 2002 between Real Madrid of Spain and Feyenoord of the Netherlands. Real Madrid qualified by beating Bayer Leverkusen in the 2002 UEFA Champions League Final. Feyenoord had made it to the Super Cup after beating Borussia Dortmund in the 2002 UEFA Cup Final. Real Madrid won the match 3–1, securing their first Super Cup win.

zh.s: 2002年欧洲超级杯于2002年8月30日举行，由西班牙皇家马德里对阵荷兰费耶诺德。皇马在2002年欧洲冠军联赛决赛中击败勒沃库森后获得参赛资格；费耶诺德则在2002年欧洲联盟杯决赛中取胜晋级。皇马以3比1获胜，首次夺得欧洲超级杯。

en.t: 2007 United States Air Force nuclear weapons incident
en.s: On 29 August 2007, six AGM-129 ACM cruise missiles, each loaded with a W80-1 variable yield nuclear warhead, were mistakenly loaded onto a United States Air Force (USAF) B-52H heavy bomber at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota and transported to Barksdale Air Force Base in Louisiana. en.s: A general election for the Japanese House of Representatives was held on August 30, 2009. The opposition Democratic Party (DPJ) defeated the ruling coalition (Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and New Komeito Party) in a sweeping victory, winning 221 of the 300 electoral districts and receiving 42.4% of the proportional block votes for another 87 seats, a total of 308 seats to only 119 for the LDP (64 districts and 26.7% of the proportional votes). Under Japan's constitution, this result virtually assured DPJ leader Yukio Hatoyama would be the next Prime Minister of Japan. He was formally named to the post on September 16, 2009.

zh.s: 日本于2009年8月30日举行众议院选举。在野的民主党（DPJ）大胜执政联盟自民党（LDP）和公明党，在300个小选区中赢得221席，并在比例代表区获得42.4%的选票、再赢得87席，总计308席；自民党仅获119席，其中小选区64席，比例代表区得票率为26.7%。根据日本宪法，这一结果几乎确定民主党领袖鸠山由纪夫将出任首相；他于2009年9月16日正式就任。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Gabon on 30 August 2009. They took place due to the death of incumbent President Omar Bongo on 8 June, after more than 41 years as the sole president of Gabon. While the constitution stated that interim President Rose Francine Rogombé should organise elections within 30 to 45 days, the Constitutional Court accepted the government's request for a delay due to the circumstances. A total of 23 candidates were approved to contest the elections, although six of them withdrew immediately before election day, reducing the field to 17 candidates.

zh.s: 加蓬于2009年8月30日提前举行总统选举。此次选举是因在任总统奥马尔·邦戈于6月8日去世而举行；他已连续担任总统超过41年。宪法规定，临时总统罗丝·弗朗辛·罗贡贝应在30至45天内组织选举，但宪法法院因当时情况接受了政府提出的延期请求。共有23名候选人获准参选，其中6人在投票日前退出，最终候选人减至17人。

en.s: State elections took place in Saxony on 30 August 2009, the same day as the Saarland and Thuringia state elections. The election results decided control of the Landtag of Saxony (Saxony's parliament). Minister-President Stanislaw Tillich's Christian Democratic Union (CDU) won enough seats in combination with their preferred partners, the Free Democratic Party (FDP) to enter into a coalition government, supplanting the grand coalition with the Social Democratic Party (SPD). On September 30, 2009 Tillich (CDU) was re-elected to the office of Minister-President in coalition with the FDP.

zh.s: 萨克森州于2009年8月30日举行州议会选举，同日萨尔州和图林根州也举行了选举。选举结果决定了萨克森州议会的席位分布。州长斯坦尼斯瓦夫·蒂利希领导的基民盟与其意向合作伙伴自民党合计获得足够席位，组成联合政府，取代此前由社民党参与的大联合政府。2009年9月30日，蒂利希在与自民党组成的联合政府中再次当选州长。

en.s: Thuringia held state elections on 30 August 2009, the same day as the Saarland and Saxony state elections. The election established the composition of the Landtag of Thuringia (Thuringia's parliament). According to the preliminary results, The Left and Social Democratic Party (SPD) together held a bare majority of seats, but a grand coalition of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and SPD was considered possible.

en.s: The 2009 Saarland state election was held on 30 August 2009 to elect the members of the Landtag of Saarland. It was held on the same day as state elections in Saxony and Thuringia. The incumbent Christian Democratic Union (CDU) government led by Minister-President Peter Müller lost its majority. The CDU subsequently formed a coalition with the Free Democratic Party (FDP) and The Greens, and Müller was re-elected as Minister-President.

en.s: The Kokang incident was a violent series of skirmishes that broke out in August 2009 in Kokang in Myanmar's northern Shan State. As a result of the conflict, the MNDAA lost control of the area and as many as 30,000 refugees fled to Yunnan in neighbouring China.

en.s: The 2020 UEFA Women's Champions League Final was the final match of the 2019–20 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 19th season of Europe's premier women's club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 11th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup to the UEFA Women's Champions League. It was played on 30 August 2020 at the Anoeta Stadium in San Sebastián, Spain, between German club VfL Wolfsburg and French club Lyon.

zh.s: 2020年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2019—20赛季欧洲女子冠军联赛的决赛。这是由欧足联主办的欧洲顶级女子俱乐部赛事第19个赛季，也是该赛事从欧洲女子联盟杯更名为欧洲女子冠军联赛后的第11个赛季。比赛于2020年8月30日在西班牙圣塞瓦斯蒂安的阿诺埃塔球场举行，由德国沃尔夫斯堡队对阵法国里昂队。

en.s: The United States Armed Forces completed their withdrawal from Afghanistan on 30 August 2021, marking the end of the 2001–2021 war. In February 2020, the first Trump administration and the Taliban signed the United States–Taliban deal in Doha, Qatar, which stipulated fighting restrictions for both the US and the Taliban, and in return for the Taliban's counter-terrorism commitments, provided for the withdrawal of all NATO forces from Afghanistan by 1 May 2021.

en.s: On 30 August 2023, a coup d'état occurred in Gabon shortly after the announcement that incumbent president Ali Bongo had won the general election held on 26 August. It was the eighth successful coup to occur in West and Central Africa since 2020. The coup's leader Brice Oligui Nguema is part of the Bongo family and overthrew his cousin Ali Bongo.

zh.s: 2023年8月30日，加蓬发生政变。当时刚宣布在8月26日举行的大选中获胜的在任总统阿里·邦戈随即被推翻。这是自2020年以来西非和中非发生的第八次成功政变。政变领导人布里斯·奥利吉·恩圭马是邦戈家族成员，也是阿里·邦戈的表亲。

en.s: The 2024 Emergence was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling. It took place on August 30, 2024, at Old Forester's Paristown Hall in Louisville, Kentucky, and aired on TNA+. It was the fifth event under the Emergence chronology. Eight matches were contested at the event, including two on the Countdown to Emergence pre-show.

en.s: The 2024 Egypt Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 Egypt Cup, the 92nd edition of the competition since its establishment in 1921. It was played between Pyramids and ZED on 30 August 2024 at Borg El Arab Stadium in Alexandria. Both teams were looking to win their first ever Egypt Cup title.

en.s: The 2025 DFB-supercup, known as Google Pixel Supercup der Frauen for sponsorship reasons, was the eighth iteration of the German women's super cup, contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and national cup competition. The match was played on 30 August 2025 at the Wildparkstadion in Karlsruhe. As Bayern Munich won both the 2024–25 Bundesliga and the 2024–25 DFB-Pokal, they faced VfL Wolfsburg as the runners-up of the Bundesliga.

zh.s: 2025年德国女子超级杯因赞助称为Google Pixel女子超级杯，是德国女子超级杯第8届赛事，由上赛季顶级联赛和德国杯冠军对决。比赛于2025年8月30日在卡尔斯鲁厄的野生公园球场举行。由于拜仁慕尼黑同时获得2024—25赛季德甲和德国杯冠军，对手因此是德甲亚军沃尔夫斯堡。
